$comment: SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT. App–CLI contract; generated fixtures come from the real binary.

x-behavior.backgroundRefresh: permitted explicit command refreshes Codex synchronously; denied Runtime scope falls through to cached quota and may schedule other admitted due readers
x-behavior.network: Codex runtime may authenticate only to its provider
x-behavior.credentials: owned by Codex; no credential import
x-behavior.floor: scheduled Codex account reads: 5 minutes after success, 30 minutes after failure; explicit --refresh-account bypasses AccountDue, while the app throttles to 300 seconds and a lock prevents overlap

exitCodes.0: quiet best-effort refresh or cached quota

x-behavior.stdout: text, not a JSON feed; never decode into account values
x-behavior.writes: permitted refresh updates the local account cache; denied scope uses ordinary quota behavior

description: Stdout is ignored by the app. Quiet permitted refresh normally emits nothing; denied scope can retain legacy human-readable quota output.
